scope_note: The bounded exact-Gaussian-collision mission is developed here. All reviewer_confirmed flags remain false until host-invoked independent review. The full memory-sample lower bound and publication novelty are not certified.

C9000140.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 140 (Memory–sample lower bounds for noiseless Gaussian regression.; papers: Memory and precision in noiseless Gaussian regression; Posterior replicas and conditional information in Gaussian regression; Localization costs and information growth for exact Gaussian observations; Projection moments, positive cap domination, and Riesz estimates on the sphere; Replacing Gaussian observations in memory-constrained inference; Subsphere methods for memory-sample lower bounds in noiseless Gaussian regression; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/140.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

GC_EXACT_VERIFICATION.statement: The actual Gaussian collision identity, its coincident normalization, and the finite-measure ordinary smoothing moment identity and finite-mass bound hold for all stated parameters without tuple-rank assumptions.

GC_GAUSSIAN_INTEGRAL.statement: For every positive-definite real Q, the actual Gaussian integral is (2*pi)^(d/2)/sqrt(det Q); the product of scalar N(0,1) laws has its normalized joint density.

GC_DETERMINANT.statement: For every rectangular D and v>0, C=D^T D+v(I+11^T) is positive definite and det C=v^q(q+1)det(I+D(I-11^T/(q+1))D^T/v).

GC_IDENTITY.statement: For every tuple, including repeated points and q>d, the actual Gaussian expectation of the label collision integral equals (2*pi)^(-m*q/2)det C^(-m/2).

GC_TONELLI.statement: For arbitrary finite nonnegative mu, the nonnegative smoothing pth moment expands against the actual unnormalized product measure mu^p.

GC_SHARP_BOUND.statement: The collision kernel is bounded by the coincident value, giving the finite moment bound p^(-m/2)(2*pi*delta^2)^(-m*(p-1)/2)mu(univ)^p with the exact full mass factor.

GC_MOMENT.statement: For every finite nonnegative mu, the ordinary integrable smoothing pth moment equals the exact collision kernel integrated against mu^p.

GC_FINITE_DENSITY.statement: The exact-label density conclusion follows conditionally from the uniform smoothing bound supplied by the ambient Gram estimate, compact-test convergence, and Lp duality.

A_AMBIENT_GRAM.statement: Under the manuscript ambient-growth assumptions, tuples have full column rank almost everywhere and their inverse Gram determinant satisfies h:dv:gram-product; if p-1>d then mu=0.

A_COMPACT_TEST_DUALITY.statement: For locally finite sigma-finite Borel lambda on Euclidean space and finite nonnegative eta, the C_c dual bound in h:proj:density-by-tests gives a nonnegative Lp density of the asserted norm.
